FAQ

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Wondering how Maya fits into your business? Let’s make it simple.

What is HomPilot?

HomPilot is a business management platform for home service contractors. Maya, its team of nine AI agents, helps with calls, quotes, booking, dispatch, billing, payments, sales, bookkeeping and marketing. HomPassport keeps customer equipment and service history in one place.

Do I need to change my phone number?

No. You can forward your existing number to Maya in minutes. Your customers call the same number — Maya answers.

How long does setup take?

Less than 10 minutes. No technical skills required. Maya is live the same day.

What if a customer speaks English?

Maya is fully bilingual. She automatically switches between French and English based on the caller.

Does Maya sound like a robot?

No. Maya uses a natural, conversational voice. Most callers don't realize they're speaking to AI.

What happens if Maya can't handle a call?

Maya automatically transfers the call to a member of your team. If no one is available, you'll instantly receive an SMS notification with the caller's contact information so you can call them back quickly.

Can I see what Maya books?

Yes. Every appointment goes straight into your calendar with the homeowner's name, issue, and contact details.

Is there a contract?

No contract. Cancel anytime. Starting at $99/month.

Does it work after hours?

That's where Maya shines. She answers at 2 AM so you wake up to confirmed appointments, not missed calls.
